mo_ta_cong_viec:
Overview
We are looking for a QC Engineer to ensure product quality across backend, web, mobile, and desktop applications.
This role combines manual testing, API testing, automation, and performance testing integrated into CI/CD pipelines.
You will work closely with engineers to validate high-concurrency, realtime systems running on Kubernetes and AWS.
Responsibilities
Design test cases, test plans, and regression test suites
Perform manual and automated testing for web, mobile, desktop, and backend APIs
Conduct API testing using Postman 
Conduct performance testing using k6 / Locust
Validate systems using Kafka, Redis, realtime flows
Integrate automation tests into CI/CD (Github Actions)
Work with developers to identify root causes and prevent defects
Maintain test documentation and quality metrics
yeu_cau:
Requirements (Must-have)
5+ years experience in QC (Prefer use AI Agent)
Strong experience in API testing
Experience with automation testing tools (Playwright)
Experience with performance testing (k6 / Locust)
Experience working in cloud / Kubernetes environment
Familiar with CI/CD pipeline integration
Nice to have
Knowledge of security testing (TLS, certificates)
Experience testing high-concurrency systems
Knowledge of SOC2 / ISO standards
quyen_loi:
Work closely with modern backend systems and cloud infrastructure
Opportunity to grow into Senior QA / QA Architect
Strong automation & performance testing exposure
